name: Amber Glass Dropper Bottle
description: A slender amber-glass dropper bottle with a brushed matte-gold metal collar and dropper cap, wrapped with a plain matte cream-colored paper band, sized for a facial serum or treatment oil.
materials: Amber (dark honey-brown) glass bottle, brushed matte-gold metal collar and dropper cap, matte-coated cream-colored paper band left blank and unprinted
primaryColors: Warm amber/honey-brown glass, matte gold hardware, cream band
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, wordmark, logo, printing, embossing, or engraving anywhere on the glass, cap, collar, or band; never add a second cap or bottle; never shift the glass color away from amber/honey-brown; no props, hands, or presenter in frame.
preservationNotes: Keep the bottle's slender cylindrical silhouette, the collar and cap's matte (never shiny/polished) gold finish, and the band's plain cream paper tone and blank surface identical in shape, proportion, and material across every angle.
